operations.title: Grothendieck publishes the selector-stabilizer quotient theorem as ledger 1284
operations.body: Ledger 1284 classifies coefficient-side quotient admission: c descends through G->G/K iff K lies in its right-translation stabilizer. Thus delta_0 has only the trivial five-site quotient, the constant trace admits all quotients but changes the observable, and intermediate selectors admit exactly stabilizer-contained kernels. Power compatibility is a later gate and cannot enlarge this kernel lattice. Exact coverage is 38,880 checks. No Betti chain pushforward or build is claimed.
